summary: Nebraska advertising agency services (copywriting, consultation, market research, media placement) are exempt, but agency fees on projects that produce advertising materials delivered to the client are taxable.

conditions.when: Project results only in services: writing copy or artwork for media, consultation, market research, compiling information, or placing advertisements in newspapers, magazines, television or radio

Project results in advertising materials (printed matter, signs, tapes, graphics) delivered to the client or its customers, with the agency acting as retailer: total billed including fees and commissions

citations.title: Reg-1-056.05D (May 14, 1994)
citations.quote: The agency will not collect tax on charges for projects that result in the advertising services listed below.

citations.title: Reg-1-056.05D(3)
citations.quote: Providing consultation or market research;

citations.title: Reg-1-056.05D(5)
citations.quote: Placing or arranging for advertisements in newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

citations.title: Reg-1-056.05E(3)
citations.quote: The agency must collect tax from the client on the total amount billed for the project including any commissions, surcharges, or agency fees connected with an advertising project that results in materials transferred to the client.

citations.title: Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-27,142(1)
citations.quote: upon the same transactions that are sourced under the provisions of sections 77-2703.01 to 77-2703.04 within such incorporated municipality on which the State of Nebraska is authorized to impose a tax pursuant to the Nebraska Revenue Act of 1967, as amended from time to time.

notes: Where a project yields both, fees are split by the relative charges (056.05E(4)); where the client appoints the agency its purchasing agent, other paragraphs of Reg-1-056 apply. Reg-1-056 is dated May 14, 1994. Nebraska's local option sales taxes apply to the same transactions as the state tax (Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-27,142), so this rule covers state and local parts.

summary: IT consulting and support that transfers no software is exempt in Nebraska; training is taxable only when paid to the seller of the software.

conditions.when: Training on software, paid to the retailer that sold the software
Work that results in software, or software updates or modifications, transferred to the customer (systems analysis, programming, installation of software)
Support bundled automatically or mandatorily with a software sale

citations.title: Reg-1-088.03 (February 22, 2009)
citations.quote: Charges for consultants who only provide generalized advice and who do not provide any software or modifications to software are exempt.

citations.title: Reg-1-088.02 (February 22, 2009)
citations.quote: Charges for customer training are taxable whenever paid to the retailer of the software. Charges for training that are paid to a person other than the retailer of the software are exempt.

citations.title: Sales Tax on Certain Services FAQs, computer software training
citations.quote: Your training services are taxable only if you also sell the computer software.

citations.title: Nebraska Sales and Use Tax FAQs, computer consulting
citations.quote: Charges for consultants who only provide generalized advice and who do not provide software or updates or modifications to software are sales tax exempt.

citations.title: Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-27,142(1)
citations.quote: upon the same transactions that are sourced under the provisions of sections 77-2703.01 to 77-2703.04 within such incorporated municipality on which the State of Nebraska is authorized to impose a tax pursuant to the Nebraska Revenue Act of 1967, as amended from time to time.

notes: The code excludes writing software. Repair of taxable hardware (labor on tangible personal property) is a taxable service under 77-2701.16(4)(f); network or help-desk work that repairs hardware may be taxable on that ground, not researched. Nebraska's local option sales taxes apply to the same transactions as the state tax (Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-27,142), so this rule covers state and local parts.

summary: Custom software, including programming, development and modification of existing software, is taxable in Nebraska.

conditions.when: Software written by a temporary employee under a written agreement meeting all three conditions of Revenue Ruling 01-02-1 (company control, no provider liability, company owns the software)

citations.title: Reg-1-088.01A (February 22, 2009)
citations.quote: The gross receipts from furnishing software includes services provided by a consultant that result in a transfer of software from the consultant to the client.

citations.title: Reg-1-088.04 (February 22, 2009)
citations.quote: Software that alters existing software is considered separate from the existing software and is taxable.

citations.title: Nebraska Sales and Use Tax FAQs, computer consulting
citations.quote: Charges for services by a consultant that result in a transfer of software, whether canned or custom, are subject to sales tax including charges for programming, program development, systems analysis, software customization and modification, upgrading of software programs, and charges for installation.

citations.title: Revenue Ruling 01-02-1 (February 11, 2002)
citations.quote: Therefore, any charges for personal services that result in software are subject to tax unless it can be shown that the payments are wages of an employee, whether temporary or permanent, who writes computer software.

citations.title: Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-27,142(1)
citations.quote: upon the same transactions that are sourced under the provisions of sections 77-2703.01 to 77-2703.04 within such incorporated municipality on which the State of Nebraska is authorized to impose a tax pursuant to the Nebraska Revenue Act of 1967, as amended from time to time.

notes: Covers both subcodes (development and modification). The 2002 ruling shows the treatment is older than 2009; 2009-02-22 is the date of Reg-1-088 as read. Website design delivered electronically or hosted is not taxable (Revenue Ruling 01-10-2), which is outside this code. Nebraska's local option sales taxes apply to the same transactions as the state tax (Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-27,142), so this rule covers state and local parts.

summary: Prewritten software is taxable in Nebraska however it is delivered, on media or by download.

citations.title: Reg-1-088.01 (February 22, 2009)
citations.quote: 088.01 The gross receipts from furnishing software regardless of the manner in which it is conveyed are taxable.

citations.title: Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-27,142(1)
citations.quote: upon the same transactions that are sourced under the provisions of sections 77-2703.01 to 77-2703.04 within such incorporated municipality on which the State of Nebraska is authorized to impose a tax pursuant to the Nebraska Revenue Act of 1967, as amended from time to time.

notes: Mandatory support or training paid to the software seller is taxable; optional, separately stated telephone support is not (FAQ). 2009-02-22 is the date of Reg-1-088 as read. No rule is written for software.saas: no Nebraska statute, regulation, ruling or DOR page read here addresses remotely accessed software (Reg-1-088 taxes software 'regardless of the manner in which it is conveyed', and Revenue Ruling 01-10-2 holds hosted website development untaxed), so SaaS is left unresearched rather than guessed. Nebraska's local option sales taxes apply to the same transactions as the state tax (Neb. Rev. Stat. 77-27,142), so this rule covers state and local parts.
